author: Existing_Subject5695
body:
Ward calculations are simple enough if you know the formula(hp+mp/2 then equip is multipled after that ie equipment and adornments) so 1000hp+500mp/2 equals base ward then it would be like x1.25(for 25 percent ward from one gear the x 1.95 for next and so on.
Hope I explained it simply and well enough to understand

author: Widogeist
body:
Probably baldr gear with jewels of creation/jewel of the end, and maybe a good Fey Yeti coat. My crappy GS alt has 62k ward with similar gear but I have immortal jewels in all my gear (+HP) I don't have any ward jewels; if I swapped them out to 2% ward I'd probably be around 90k or higher (zero ascension levels). A good offhand like Arisen Shield makes a significant difference, and a primary weapon with ward helps. My alt uses Ymir Staff of Zaltys which has around 40% ward (including adorns).

Both HP and Mana contribute to your overall ward. Using items like Baldr gear (which gives a crapload of HP + ward) and Fey Yeti Coat (which gives a lot of HP + mana + ward) will add a lot. Throw in armor adornments which give hp+mana+ward (JoC, Jotes, etc), that will boost it even more.
